stories.title: Emmy Awards move from primetime TV to streaming giant in new six-year deal

en.title: Emmy Awards move from primetime TV to streaming giant in new six-year deal
en.summary: The Emmy Awards are shifting from traditional broadcast television to a streaming platform under a new six-year agreement. The move follows the awards show's historically lower viewership compared to other major award ceremonies.

stories.title: Paramount takes over Warner Bros in $110bn Hollywood merger

en.title: Paramount takes over Warner Bros in $110bn Hollywood merger
en.summary: Paramount is acquiring Warner Bros in a $110 billion deal combining two major Hollywood studios. The merger concludes after previous legal disputes and competitive concerns.

stories.title: Badenoch warns Tories they will not be allowed back if they defect to Reform as she rules out coalition with Farage

en.title: Badenoch warns Tories they will not be allowed back if they defect to Reform as she rules out coalition with Farage
en.summary: Conservative Party leader Badenoch stated that defectors to Reform UK will not be readmitted and rejected forming a coalition with Nigel Farage's party, preferring multiple elections if needed.

stories.title: I'd rather have another election than do a deal with Reform UK, says Badenoch

en.title: I'd rather have another election than do a deal with Reform UK, says Badenoch
en.summary: Badenoch reaffirmed her opposition to a coalition with Reform UK, stating she would prefer holding another election instead. She also committed to reducing hiring costs for young workers aged 21-24.

stories.title: Student admits murdering woman in 'Dexter' kill room

en.title: Student admits murdering woman in 'Dexter' kill room
en.summary: A 20-year-old forensics student has admitted to murdering a woman after luring her to an Airbnb.

stories.title: PCs who Tasered and pepper-sprayed care home resident, 92, barred from policing

en.title: PCs who Tasered and pepper-sprayed care home resident, 92, barred from policing
en.summary: Two police officers have been barred from policing after using a Taser and pepper spray against a 92-year-old care home resident.

stories.title: State parliament elects Germany’s first far-right speaker since second world war

en.title: State parliament elects Germany's first far-right speaker since second world war
en.summary: Tobias Rausch from the far-right AfD party was elected speaker of Saxony-Anhalt's state parliament, marking the first time since World War II that a far-right party has secured such a position in a German regional parliament.

stories.title: LIV Golf secures $300m funding commitment for 2027 relaunch after bankruptcy filing

en.title: LIV Golf secures $300m funding commitment for 2027 relaunch after bankruptcy filing
en.summary: LIV Golf has obtained a $300 million funding commitment for a 2027 relaunch following its recent bankruptcy filing, which came after Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund withdrew support.

stories.title: British national arrested in connection with RAF Fairford incident

en.title: British national arrested in connection with RAF Fairford incident
en.summary: A British national has been arrested in connection with an incident near RAF Fairford last month, marking the seventh arrest related to this event.

stories.title: What do we know about death of anti-plague institute worker in Russia and is there a wider risk?

en.title: What do we know about death of anti-plague institute worker in Russia and is there a wider risk?
en.summary: A 28-year-old laboratory technician died following an incident at a Russian anti-plague research facility. Russia disputes plague as the cause, though experts continue to raise questions about the circumstances.

stories.title: Watch: How Russia responded to US after plague researcher death

en.title: Watch: How Russia responded to US after plague researcher death
en.summary: Following the death of a plague researcher, the United States and Russia have each offered assistance to one another in addressing infectious disease challenges.

stories.title: Plague risk to UK 'very low', officials say after Russian woman's death

en.title: Plague risk to UK 'very low', officials say after Russian woman's death
en.summary: UK health authorities have assessed the risk of plague transmission to the United Kingdom as very low following the death of a laboratory worker in Russia who may have had exposure to pneumonic plague.

stories.title: Palmer Luckey’s Erebor surges to more than $7bn in deposits since launch

en.title: Palmer Luckey's Erebor surges to more than $7bn in deposits since launch
en.summary: Erebor, a technology-focused startup bank, has accumulated over $7 billion in deposits since its launch, positioning itself to serve the sector following Silicon Valley Bank's collapse.

en.title: S&P 500 hits record high as AI stocks shrug off bond market slump
en.summary: The S&P 500 reached a new peak despite weakness in bond markets, with the index's gains increasingly concentrated among a small number of technology stocks.

en.summary: Tobias Rausch from a far-right party won election as a regional parliament president through secret support from members of established parties.

en.summary: France is experiencing a pre-election bond market sell-off that some observers worry could destabilize the broader Eurozone economy.

en.title: Vitol chief warns of tanker shortage and risk of $200-a-barrel oil
en.summary: The leader of the world's largest independent oil trader cautions that a shipping shortage is creating bottlenecks in oil distribution despite higher flows from the Gulf region.
